source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The chat content sink removes unsupported CSS properties from a live style list and decrements the index after removal so the next property is still inspected. It drops an empty style attribute, then sorts the remaining textual declarations for comparison while preserving whether there was a trailing semicolon. The lint rename to styleAttrs changes the local name, not this behavior. Treat mutation order and serialization as part of the sanitizer contract when simplifying the loop. This is not a formatter rule or proof that all possible CSS input is sanitized.
title: Preserve live-list mutation and stable style serialization during cleanup
